seasonRows.notes: District 5. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Stuie, about 113 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.61542, -126.38887, pull off on North Machmell Main FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 270 m SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-7, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.
